evidence.value: Triage policy TR-7. Check in this order. (1) ACTIVE_ADVERSARY if, in the 60 minutes before the alert, a non-admin principal performed an IAM privilege escalation AND more than 1 GB left the VPC to a destination outside the allowlist. (2) CONFIG_ERROR if a ConfigMap or Deployment change happened in the 30 minutes before the alert. (3) HARDWARE_FAILURE if a node went NotReady in the 30 minutes before the alert. (4) Otherwise UNKNOWN.
